meta.title: IDSS EGE: External matura preparation
meta.description: Internationale Deutsche Schule Sarajevo platform preparing Grade 9 students for the external matura.

home.title: IDSS EGE
home.subtitle: External matura preparation through challenges, missions and practice based exclusively on the official exam catalogues.
home.statusBody: Sprint 02 is in progress: the canonical document registry with a permanent version history, activation and restoring earlier versions.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Sign in with your username and password.
auth.usernameHint: Staff: official e-mail address. Students: the username issued by the school.

errors.VALIDATION: Enter a valid username and password.
errors.LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: Sign-in is currently unavailable. Please try again later.

account.nextStepsBody: Your workspace is being built in the coming sprints. Sign-in, roles and data protection are active.

accounts.title: Account management
accounts.subtitle: Create accounts, set status, rights and passwords. Every change is logged.
accounts.forbidden: You do not have access to this page.
accounts.usernameHintStudent: Student: school-issued username (no e-mail), e.g. firstname.lastname.
accounts.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. Hand the password over in person.
accounts.empty: There are no accounts yet apart from yours.
accounts.subjectTeacherNote: A subject teacher reviews questions, answer keys and rules of their own subject only.
accounts.tokenNote: Note: blocking stops new sign-ins immediately; an already open session ends within 1 hour at the latest.

errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.USERNAME_ROLE_MISMATCH: Administrators use an e-mail as username; students must not.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: The action failed. Please try again.

accounts.noSubjects: Subjects are not loaded yet. In the canonical document registry, run "Load subject and rules" for each catalogue.

canon.title: Canonical document registry
canon.subtitle: The official sources behind all content. Every version is kept permanently, nothing is deleted.
canon.uploadIntro: PDF only, at most 50 MB. A new version waits for validation and becomes valid only when you activate it.
canon.reasonHint: Required to roll back, reject and archive. Stored in the history.

confirm.activate: Activate this version? The currently valid version will be superseded.

messages.REGISTERED: The version is registered and awaits activation.

errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than 50 MB.
errors.NOT_PDF: The file is not a PDF document.
errors.UPLOAD_MISSING: The file did not arrive. Please try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The document or version does not exist.
errors.INVALID_TRANSITION: This change is not allowed in the current status.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: The service is currently unavailable. Please try again.

common.errorBody: The data could not be loaded. Please try again in a moment.

ingestion.title: Question extraction
ingestion.none: No questions have been extracted from this version yet.
ingestion.confirm: Extract the questions from this version? The result is stored as a new run; earlier runs stay in the history.
ingestion.declaredMismatch: Count does NOT match the catalogue
ingestion.untrusted: Nothing extracted is verified yet: questions reach students only after teacher review (Sprint 04).

messages.INGESTED: Extracted: {units} questions or tasks, {scored} scored units.

errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.INVALID_TRANSITION: Only valid versions and versions awaiting validation are extracted.
errors.NO_PROFILE: There is no reviewed extraction profile for this catalogue edition. A new edition needs a new profile.
errors.INTEGRITY: The stored file does not match the registered one (SHA-256). Nothing was extracted.
errors.SOURCE_MISSING: The stored file was not found.
errors.NO_TEXT_LAYER: The PDF has no text layer (scanned document). An OCR decision is needed.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: The service is currently unavailable. Please try again.

flagTexts.noAudio: Listening task: no official audio, only the transcript

flagTexts.unclassified: Task type not recognised from the wording
flagTexts.keyCount: Number of answers does not match the number of items
flagTexts.structure: Task structure does not match the catalogue

facts.title: Subject and exam rules
facts.intro: Subject name and exam rules (duration, points, test composition, aids) with a verbatim quote and page from this catalogue. Every quote is checked in the stored PDF before it is saved.
facts.confirm: Load the subject and rules from this catalogue version?
facts.none: No rules are prepared for this catalogue edition.

errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.INVALID_TRANSITION: Rules are loaded only from an active catalogue or one awaiting validation.
errors.NO_FACTS: No rules are prepared for this catalogue edition.
errors.INTEGRITY: The stored file does not match the registered one (SHA-256).
errors.SOURCE_MISSING: The stored file was not found.
errors.QUOTE_MISMATCH: A quote was not found on its page. Nothing was saved.
errors.ALREADY_LOADED: The rules of this version are already loaded.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: The service is not available right now. Please try again.

review.title: Review of questions and rules
review.subtitle: The teacher checks every extracted record beside the original catalogue page. Students only get accepted questions.
review.noSubjects: Subjects are not loaded yet. The Superadministrator loads them in the canonical document registry ("Load subject and rules").
review.noScope: No subject is assigned to you for review.
review.noQueue: There are no extracted questions from the active catalogue for this subject yet.

record.noKey: The catalogue gives no answer for this task.
record.readOnly: This record comes from an older extraction or version and cannot be changed.
record.compareHint: Compare the extracted text with the original page: task text, answer options, formulas and answer key.
record.notFound: The record does not exist or is not from your subject.

decision.title: Decision
decision.reasonHint: What is wrong, e.g. a missing option, a wrong answer, a broken formula.
decision.confirmAccept: Accept this record as checked? The decision is final; the answer can later be corrected by a revision.
decision.acceptedNote: Accepted. The question is checked and can be used.

keys.title: Answer key and revisions
keys.hint: The printed answer is never changed. The revision is stored beside it and becomes the effective answer.

source.alt: Region of the original catalogue page, record {key}

rules.title: Exam rules
rules.intro: Every rule has a verbatim quote and page from the catalogue. Confirm that the rule was read correctly, or dispute it with a note.
rules.empty: The rules for this subject are not loaded yet.
